assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PNG for a cute chibi Three Kingdoms 2D strategy game. Thick warm dark brown hand ink outlines, chunky friendly forms, crisp cel shading, teal cloth, warm wood and ivory parchment, restrained bronze accents. True transparent alpha outside the object, no checkerboard, no words, text, letters, numbers or watermark. A landscape 3:2 EMPTY illustrated military commander selection board inside a tent, frontal view, intended 1110x740 pixels. A broad near-rectangular ivory parchment stretched in a slim sturdy wood frame. The top edge has an integrated blank warm wooden title crest, centered x14-45%,y5-14%. LEFT page x7-49%,y17-78% is entirely clean flat parchment reserved for six character stands; RIGHT area x56-92%,y16-74% has a very pale muted teal cloth backdrop fading to warm ivory at bottom, with two slim short decorative banner poles at far right edge only, reserved for one large separately composited character. No individual card frames or boxes. Bottom x8-91%,y82-92% has a continuous low wood rail with broad empty pale parchment area directly above it for lineup controls. Central divide only a faint ink flourish, no wall. Perspective nearly flat, edges rectangular not trapezoid. Outer silhouette contained within 3% transparent margins. No characters, weapons, symbols or buttons painted in. Entire illustration is an independent UI stage, not a full scene.
